name: MonarchLink
title: Link
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.Text with androidx.compose.foundation.clickable; androidx.compose.ui.text.LinkAnnotation with androidx.compose.ui.text.TextLinkStyles for links inside text
summary: A text link in the variants inline, standalone and subtle: MonarchLink for a link that is an element of its own, and MonarchLinkDefaults.styles() for a link inside a sentence.
whenToUse: MonarchLink for a link under a field, at the end of a row, in a footer or after a paragraph. A LinkAnnotation with MonarchLinkDefaults.styles() for words inside a sentence that open a page.
whenNotToUse: For an action that changes something (save, delete, send) use MonarchButton, in the Ghost variant when it must look light. For the top-level destinations of an app use a NavigationBar or NavigationRail (see top-nav).
api: @Composable fun MonarchLink(text: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchLinkVariant = MonarchLinkVariant.Inline, enabled: Boolean = true, external: Boolean = false, trailingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, externalLabel: String? = null, actionLabel: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)
enum class MonarchLinkVariant { Inline, Standalone, Subtle }
object MonarchLinkDefaults { @Composable fun styles(variant: MonarchLinkVariant = MonarchLinkVariant.Inline): TextLinkStyles }

options.name: text
options.description: The link text. Say where it goes.

options.name: onClick
options.description: Opens the destination: a screen of the app, or a URL with LocalUriHandler.current.openUri(url). Not called when disabled.

options.name: variant
options.description: Inline: link color, underlined. Standalone: link color, medium weight, underlined while pressed or focused. Subtle: muted text color, which turns to the default text color and underlined while pressed or focused.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the link can be activated.

options.name: external
options.description: Whether the link leaves the app. TalkBack reads externalLabel after the text.

options.name: trailingIcon
options.description: An icon after the text, such as an arrow for an external link. It takes the link color. Monarch bundles no icon.

options.name: externalLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "opens in the browser" (monarch_link_external).

options.name: actionLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "open link" (monarch_link_action), read by TalkBack as "double tap to open link".

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the press, focus and hover interactions.

options.name: MonarchLinkDefaults.styles(variant)
options.description: The same look for a LinkAnnotation.Url or LinkAnnotation.Clickable inside an annotated string, with pressed, hovered and focused styles.

states.name: resting
states.description: Inline is underlined in the link color; standalone is the link color in medium weight; subtle is the muted text color.

states.name: pressed, hovered or focused
states.description: Every variant is underlined; subtle takes the default text color. A focused link also shows the focus ring.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The disabled text color; announced as disabled and does not respond.

states.name: high contrast
states.description: In the two high-contrast themes every variant is underlined at rest, so a link is not told from text by color alone.

states.name: external
states.description: TalkBack reads "opens in the browser" after the text; an optional trailing icon shows it.

appearance: Text in the link role (inline, standalone) or the muted text role (subtle, turning to the default text role when pressed), the disabled text role when disabled; the underline is the text color. No background. The high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colors and underline every variant.
platformNotes: The parity map lists Link as build on Android and as a ButtonStyle (MonarchLinkStyle) on iOS. Compose has no link control, so Android builds MonarchLink, with the same variant names and the same external label. Like the web link, an Inline or Subtle link takes the type size of the surrounding text (LocalTextStyle); wrap it in ProvideTextStyle(MonarchTheme.typography.caption) for a smaller one. A Standalone link is an element of its own and is label size (14sp, medium weight) like the text of a button, whatever surrounds it. The web underlines inline links at 40% of the text color; Monarch does not dim with opacity, so the underline is full strength. The web's hover underline for standalone and subtle is applied on press, focus and pointer hover. iOS underlines every variant when Button Shapes is on; Android has no such setting, so the high-contrast themes do it. Where an external URL opens is the app's decision: the plan mentions Custom Tabs, which needs androidx.browser, not a Monarch dependency; LocalUriHandler opens the default browser, and an app that wants Custom Tabs provides its own UriHandler through LocalUriHandler. The web's asChild has no equivalent; target="_blank" is the explicit external flag. Compose has no link role, so a MonarchLink is announced as an actionable element whose action is "open link"; a LinkAnnotation inside text is announced as a link by TalkBack.
accessibility: The link is one TalkBack element with its text; its click action is named "open link", so TalkBack says "double tap to open link".
An external link is read with "opens in the browser" after its text.
The touch target is at least 48dp high and wide, reserved in the layout; the visible text is centered vertically in it.
Pressed and focused states are shown by an underline, not by color alone, and the high-contrast themes underline every variant at rest.
A disabled link is announced as disabled and does not call onClick.
The text wraps at large font sizes, and the trailing icon follows the text in both layout directions.
edgeCases: The 48dp target makes a MonarchLink taller than a line of text: it is not meant to sit inside a paragraph. Use a LinkAnnotation there.
Links inside text (LinkAnnotation) are only as tall as the line; Compose does not enlarge them. Keep them to words that are not crowded by other links.
Without ProvideTextStyle an Inline or Subtle link uses the body style that MonarchTheme provides through Material 3; a Standalone link is always label size (14sp).
A trailing icon is decoration; give it a null content description and use external for the spoken note.

examples.title: Variants and external
examples.template:
val uriHandler = LocalUriHandler.current
FlowRow(
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space4),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space4),
) {
    MonarchLink(text = {{links.0.label}}, onClick = {}, variant = MonarchLinkVariant.{{links.0.variant|pascal}})
    MonarchLink(text = {{links.1.label}}, onClick = {}, variant = MonarchLinkVariant.{{links.1.variant|pascal}})
    MonarchLink(text = {{links.2.label}}, onClick = {}, variant = MonarchLinkVariant.{{links.2.variant|pascal}})
    MonarchLink(
        text = {{links.3.label}},
        onClick = { uriHandler.openUri({{links.3.href}}) },
        variant = MonarchLinkVariant.{{links.3.variant|pascal}},
        external = {{links.3.external}},
    )
}
examples.code:
val uriHandler = LocalUriHandler.current
FlowRow(
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space4),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space4),
) {
    MonarchLink(text = "Inline link", onClick = {}, variant = MonarchLinkVariant.Inline)
    MonarchLink(text = "Standalone link", onClick = {}, variant = MonarchLinkVariant.Standalone)
    MonarchLink(text = "Subtle link", onClick = {}, variant = MonarchLinkVariant.Subtle)
    MonarchLink(
        text = "Rook website",
        onClick = { uriHandler.openUri("https://rookhq.com") },
        variant = MonarchLinkVariant.Inline,
        external = true,
    )
}
